name: ThermaSol Vera 2-3 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description A stylish outdoor sauna designed for modern living, the Vera Sauna Cabin brings light, openness and warmth to smaller spaces like patios, balconies, rooftops or garden nooks. Experience a private yet open feel with the Vera's mirrored Parsol argon insulated glass walls, which are thermally protected and reflect the outdoor landscape while subtly concealing the sauna room's interior. Framed in black enamel for superior durability against the outdoor elements, the exterior of the sauna additionally offers excellent solar protection to enjoy sauna sessions in comfort. Bathers enter the interior through a flush glass door, greeted by high-quality Tyrol wood walls, high-density resin composite flooring and thermo-aspen benches and backrests. The multi-layer insulation ensures superior heat retention and efficiency while the Harvia Virta swiftly generates plentiful heat and steam. RGB LED lighting is emitted from recessed locations throughout the cabin, with the included control creating a custom ambiance for a calming retreat. Supported by a 1-year warranty, the ThermaSol Vera outdoor sauna offers privacy without compromising its modern style to establish an inviting wellness atmosphere for year-round performance. Features Parsol argon insulated semi-private tempered glass for UV protection, enhanced thermal efficiency and privacy Thermally modified Tyrol wood interior walls for an authentic Scandinavian appearance complimenting the high-density wood composite flooring Thermo-aspen benches and backrests for smooth, superior comfort while resistant to moisture and warping Multi-layer wall insulation to improve heat retention and energy efficiency Integrated rainwater management system for all=season weatherproofing Harvia Virta electric sauna heater for powerful, evenly distributed heating performance Harvia Xenio sauna control touchpad to adjust time and temperature with repeat scheduling and WiFi connectivity through the MyHarvia App Full-spectrum recessed LED lighting with independent controls for a personalized ambiance Perfect for balconies, rooftops, patios, or small garden spaces Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use Dimensions: 63"W (160 cm) x 87" (221 cm) x 89" (226 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia Virta 8kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3020 Sauna Stones (3) Temperature Sensor Headrest (2) Wood Platform MyHarvia App Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 2-3 people Exterior (W × D × H): 63″ × 87″ × 89″ Heater: Harvia 8kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Specification Sheet
